description: Build a <meta name="robots" content="..."> tag from flag directives (noindex, nofollow, noarchive, nosnippet, notranslate, noimageindex, none, all, indexifembedded) plus optional max-snippet, max-image-preview, max-video-preview, and unavailable_after value directives, the exact same directive vocabulary as the X-Robots-Tag header. Scope the tag to a single crawler with name (e.g. "googlebot") instead of the default "robots".

maxImagePreview.description: Max image preview size shown in search results

maxSnippet.description: Max text snippet length in characters; 0 shows no snippet, -1 means no limit

maxVideoPreview.description: Max video preview length in seconds; 0 shows no preview, -1 means no limit

name.description: Optional crawler name to scope the tag to via its name attribute, e.g. "googlebot" (default "robots")

unavailableAfter.description: Stop showing this page in search results after this date/time

name: build_robots_meta_tag
